description: The file defines the SessionManager class responsible for handling user authentication sessions, including login, token refresh, and logout, using secure storage (Keychain). It manages access tokens and refresh tokens, ensuring secure and persistent user sessions within an iOS application.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A class managing user session states, including authentication status, tokens, and session persistence.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Restores existing authentication tokens from secure storage and validates them, refreshing if necessary.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password, storing tokens securely upon success.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Provides a valid access token, refreshing it if needed, or throws if not authenticated.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clearing session data both in memory and secure storage.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes access token if expired or about to expire.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates internal token state with a new pair of tokens.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Saves tokens and their expiry time to secure storage.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears session tokens from secure storage and memory.
